name: Toponym v1
comment: Location metonymy (ReLocaR, SemEval locations). Sorts: the place itself, the polities (executive or legislative bodies) acting for it, the sports teams representing it, and its people. Edges mirror Wikidata: P208 executive body, P194 legislative body, teams from P1532/P159 with a sport (P641), residents (always defined). No declared equivalences yet.

edges.name: exec
edges.reading: the executive government of the place

edges.name: team
edges.reading: a sports team representing the place

edges.name: pop
edges.reading: the people living in the place
